subject: reasoning
question:
Six numbers, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10, are written on the different faces of a dice. Two positions of this dice are shown in the given figure. Find the number on the face opposite to 5

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/14e2966336e00f2d42cc4c4f0990d4aa51a51d1c7f6c4f3ffee4bea332c3775f.png]
solution:
For find the opposite surface of '5', we need to compare the common surface in the given dices,

So, From Dice 1 and Dice 2,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/52d6ab283b75fa0add5bbe3dabb593fa2969d44f05eb749c030966e0834056c3.png] 

From both dices, 10 is common. So, we can rotate in clockwise direction.

7 is opposite to 8.

6 is opposite to 9.

So, 5 will be opposite to 10.

Hence, the correct answer is "10".
